lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-ordered grid, with smaller, more densely packed spots near the gill slits transitioning to larger, more widely spaced spots moving posteriorly and dorsally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice-like appearance where spots often serve as the centers of the grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear ridge runs horizontally across the upper flank, marked by a sharp intensity gradient transition from a bright dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish visible near the ventral surface and posterior to the pectoral fin.
